name: Seidou Erisu
source:
Birthday: I won't tell you my date of birth!
Likes: Interesting thighs (facts), reading people's hearts.
Dislikes: Being disgraced, being robbed. Long baths.

[url=/c50122]Tsurumi[/url]'s younger sister and a first year student at Seidou Gakuen who is rapidly gaining fans and admirers. Behind Erisu's lack of emotions she hides a mischievous and scheming personality.

[Translated from [url=https://gyutto.com/af-256/i/item12618?map=end%3f&select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url].]
